serverLogSummary.authlibTimeout: Yggdrasil public-key request timed out in offline mode; unrelated to chunk loading and the server still started and saved cleanly

limitations: one flat 1.21.4 world and one full chunk were tested; no entities, block entities or structures existed in the source chunk
a single server load/stop round-trip is not a universal vanilla parity proof
chest, oak_sign and barrel survived as blocks but no block entity records were created; their inventories/state are not valid for gameplay
heightmaps and light arrays stayed unchanged even after the surface block was removed and a torch was placed; the edited chunk can be stale until the game or a later stage recalculates them
POI was updated for the barrel by the server, but the writer itself does not update poi/ sidecars and this was observed for one POI block only
